prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE coherent premium character concept sheet for WHISPERER, an original dark astral camp companion in Kindred Siege. Adult, referred to as she, but her sex, age and species are deliberately impossible to place. Beautiful, threatening, composed and quietly amused. An ascended being obsessed with perfect presentation, in a culture whose currency is supremacy rather than possessions. She survived beside the protagonist and is one of his trusted friends; a PERSON with wry charm, not a mindless monster. Her camp responsibility is skins and regalia; do not illustrate combat. This is a proposed appearance, no literal existing franchise character.

COMPOSITION: warm neutral grey studio background. Landscape sheet: large complete head-to-toe three-quarter figure occupying left 60 percent, generous silhouette clearance; right upper a large close portrait of THE SAME face; right lower one detail of her lower hands shaping living regalia. Simple subtle contact shadow, restrained dark body mist, no environmental scenery. No text or labels. Painterly realism for anatomy and surfaces, precise readable design shapes rather than noisy detail. Realistic heroic anatomy about seven-and-a-half heads tall.

ONE-SECOND IDENTITY: a poised FOUR-ARMED astral court figure with an elongated smooth swept-back head, a dark mirror-nacre body and a severe vertical silhouette. Her extraordinary anatomy must distinguish her from a conventional sorceress. Four arms are purposeful and clearly separated: the upper pair long, relaxed and spacious, one hand gently lifted as if making a dry conversational point and the other resting by her outer hip; the smaller lower pair originate naturally just below the ribcage and work together holding a single broad strip of living regalia at waist height. Anatomically convincing shoulder roots and complete hands. Intact body, not an injury design. Graceful weight through both legs, composed upright pose, not a pinup or an action stance. Moderate athletic mass, long powerful neck, substantial shoulders; elegant rather than emaciated.

FACE: striking severe alien beauty, asymmetrical knowing expression with one corner of the short mouth lifted almost imperceptibly. Two lateral eyes only, long narrow almond sockets filled with dark reflective material and small muted antique-gold irises; NO glow. Smooth high brow, broad planar cheekbones, no external ears, and a very flat central breathing ridge with tiny subtle seams instead of a protruding human nose. A compact expressive mouth, not large fashion lips or a monster grin. The jaw and temples flow into a smooth elongated backward-swept cranial shell. This cranium is her living opaque anatomy, not a helmet. No horns, headgear, crest spikes, hair, dreads, transparent brain, third eye or halo. Face and long fingers convey alert intelligence, concealed amusement and absolute self-possession.

SKIN AND TRANSFORMATION: living mother-of-pearl material, transformed almost entirely alien. Predominantly dark smoky plum and black-violet nacre with cool pewter-lilac highlights on face, throat, upper arms and torso. Broad quiet areas of beautiful skin; restrained subtle fine biological layering. Along one temple, one shoulder and parts of the lower arms the material grades into perfectly polished volcanic glass, as if sections of her own skin have become a flawless dark mirror. These polished areas are integrated augmentation, with small worn ancient-gold junctions. It is not an armour suit worn over purple human skin. Avoid all-over scales, cracks, starfield textures and ornament noise.

REGALIA IS EMBODIED: black material grows from the body in a few broad, deliberate shapes, with smooth visible transitions from skin into obsidian and then pliable matte-black membrane. A seamless asymmetrical band crosses the upper torso and joins into one broad hip sheath; opaque coverage over chest and pelvis, clear exposed abdomen/flanks, shoulders, all four arms and lower legs. Two straight substantial black membrane panels descend closely BEHIND the body from the shoulder-blade growths to calf level. They form a narrow vertical frame with clear attachment points and slight weight, no wide flare and no pile on the floor. Sparse ancient-gold surfaces at growth joins only, no embroidered edging. No separate dress, bodice, corset, sleeves, hood, tailored robe, belt, boots, high heels, jewellery clutter, wings, moth shapes, feathers, petal skirts or floating shards. Bare alien feet have strong stable compact anatomy and dark grown sole plates, no webbing or claws. Her regalia is restrained and sculptural, not another wizard costume.

WORKING GESTURE: her smaller lower hands each grip one end of a continuous palm-wide curved strip of dark flexible material. A single face of the strip transitions from matte black to rich deep purple mother-of-pearl to polished obsidian along its length. It is physically supported between her fingers, a clear tangible sample of living regalia, no floating magic ribbons or visible new game power. Repeat these same hands/material in the lower-right detail. No needles, sewing kit, book, staff, orb, weapon or shopping props.

AURA / LIGHT: a sparse low black mist escapes near collarbone and wrists and curls deliberately toward the sample without obscuring anatomy. Soft neutral key light shows black shapes against the grey background; gentle cool fill, metallic gold remains old and restrained. Rich void black, smoky deep purple, subdued pearl, old gold. Absolutely no neon, bright pink, bright cyan, rainbow iridescence or glowing effects.

Original character. Do not reproduce Slaanesh symbols, Warhammer demon faces, crab claws, hooves, theatrical masks, peacock fans or franchise costume. Do not copy the leader's transparent brain, three eyes, dreads or crown. Keep main figure, portrait and hand study consistent. The visual priority is an arresting alien face, coherent four-arm anatomy, embodied black regalia, and the personality of a beautiful threatening trusted companion.
